The preposition has the same small looped d and low trailing e as the nearby de, with no u shoulder.
Two short raised strokes stand before the capital G; there is no angular guillemet.
The close consists of two high short strokes to the right of strictes.

A short oblique stroke and a flattened linked trace with a tiny raised mark sit above the line; the long curved guide descends into the gap before les. These support où, but the letter bodies remain too reduced for certainty.
The two dotted i positions, long p descender, and final linked mes trace are legible in the half; no competing word is needed.
Two crossing strokes extend to the full height of the adjacent mathematical capitals; a distinct low point follows the X.
The second crossing letter is full-height, independently inspected. The raised minus and separate upright 1 are distinct.
A longer bowed upper stroke rises, flattens and turns slightly up at its right end above a shorter straight lower stroke. This favours similarity over a bar, while an uneven equals remains possible.
The word has a compact c-o-m-m-e-n sequence and a terminal tall/crossed t; the many extra letters of commutativement are absent.
Two tall adjacent t strokes and one shared extended cross-stroke precede a low terminal e trace. There are no separate o and u bodies between the t stems.
An initial low r/é trace has a detached raised mark, followed by a looped d and a terminal tall crossed t. The intervening u/i strokes flatten together, so the whole word remains uncertain.
The crop separates the small initial a, tall open b, low linked ou, crossed t, dotted i and final t. The ending is it, with two t stems sharing an extended cross-stroke.

notes: Author page 4 continues an already begun word with the visible ending pé. No preceding-page text was consulted or reconstructed. Archive pencil foliation reads 149; H already acknowledges both numbers in its note.

The author refers, with the explicit qualification je pense, to Mme Sinh and the chapter on strict Gr-categories. He describes the associativity, unit and inverse isomorphisms as identities in the strict case.

The author says that calculations with Gr-categories reduce to algebraic calculations with strict ones through a calculus of fractions, at right or left by choice, compared with the construction of derived categories. This is an account of the written claim, not its verification.

The author introduces a structure described by (L1,L0,d,Theta), with a group homomorphism L1 to L0 and an operation of L0 on L1 through underlined Aut_gr. The page ends after avec les and supplies no further conditions on this sheet.

Mathematical context prompted careful inspection of the inverse relation, both X capitals, the two lower indices, the case of the action symbol, and the directions and decoration of the displayed arrows. Decisions in the transcription use visible ink, without mathematical repair.

The C doubts at tte and aboutit are resolved. Its doubts at the small insertion, inverse relation, réduit and first Theta remain; the cancelled symbol keeps a wider explicit Theta/theta/0 set. H leaves isomorphismes uncertain although the half resolves it.

The single wavy underline is at the first strictes; the second strictes has a single almost straight underline. H’s note reverses the waveform attribution. The required uline macro is used for each, with a page comment and separate report entries recording the geometry.

Two possible punctuation traces omitted by both witnesses are explicitly uncertain: the low point before quadruplet and a raised paired point right of the first displayed L0. The latter is raised typographically to retain its placement, without treating it as an identified mathematical exponent. Other scattered small points above the first display and below the action colon have no coherent attachment and were assessed as surface spots.

The start timestamp is the first recorded UTC timestamp, after the initial supplied-text read. The ordered view log records actual image views only: one whole, half a, half b, then each of ten distinct crops once. Each crop was produced by out/scripts/crop.py at width 2800 with its default contrast 1.12 and rotation 0; no unresolved writing required rotation.

coverage: I read the whole-page layout once, then each supplied half once in order, comparing every prose line and mathematical item with the complete C and H texts. This included the agreed words, accents, plural endings, punctuation, quotation strokes, all underlines, the interlinear insertion and its guide, the inline inverse formula, the tuple, both displayed maps and their arrow directions, the cancelled final symbol, author page number and archival foliation. All remaining nominated loci were examined in one tight crop apiece. H omits the small interlinear word and misreads several words, abbreviations and letter cases; both witnesses omit two small marks whose status remains uncertain. No margin prose, separate drawing, typed material, date or signature is present on this sheet. The two prose paragraphs and final continuation are transcribed in full with the single insertion and certain deletion state preserved. No proof check, independent re-proof, computation or mathematical certification was performed.
